definitions.explanation: The time period in the late afternoon when the sun begins to set, roughly from 4-7 PM.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{夕方|ゆうがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll come home in the evening.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: Let's meet around 5 PM in the evening.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{涼|すず}しく→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけます→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: When evening comes, it gets cool outside, so I go out for a walk.

notes:
{夕方|ゆうがた} refers to evening or dusk—the time when the sun sets, roughly 4-7 PM.

COMPONENTS:
{夕|ゆう} (evening) + {方|がた} (direction/time) = evening time

TIME SEQUENCE:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: morning
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧: noon/daytime
- {夕方|ゆうがた}: evening/dusk
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: night

RELATED {夕|ゆう} WORDS:
- ⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧: dinner
- ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧: sunset, setting sun
- ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧: evening glow
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}: evening newspaper
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧: twilight, dusk

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {夕方|ゆうがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to return home in the evening
- {夕方|ゆうがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: evening comes
- {夕方|ゆうがた}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from evening

{夕方|ゆうがた} often signals the end of work and commuting home time.
